entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire and former Benalish knight, security chief of Jhoira's crew on the Weatherlight, who struggles to uphold knightly ideals.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, to whom Arvad swore allegiance.

entities.name: Kazarov
entities.description: Descendant of the Sengir line who turned Arvad into a vampire.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Angel who introduced Arvad to Jhoira and was defended by him at the construction site.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Searched for spare parts with Tiana and Raff.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: Searched for spare parts with Tiana and Shanna.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Where Arvad was left in charge of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Weatherlight was compleated.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Realm Arvad served as a knight.

events.summary: Kazarov turns Arvad into a vampire.
events.quote: Kazarov , a descendant of the notorious Sengir line, turned Arvad into a vampire.

events.summary: Compelled to the Weatherlight's construction site, Arvad helps Tiana defend the ship against a Bogardan phoenix; Tiana introduces him to Jhoira and he swears allegiance.
events.quote: The angel introduced Arvad to Jhoira, after which he swore allegiance to the captain.

events.summary: During the Second Phyrexian Invasion Arvad is left in charge of the Weatherlight on Otaria but cannot prevent its Compleation.
events.quote: he was unable to prevent the ship's Compleation
